title: Everpure monthly research roundup (30d)
executive_summary: This month’s research is centered on EDC Blueprint Page, Accelerate Live Stream, Contextual Intelligence PDP. The strongest value is decision-shaping rather than broad launch approval: each track points to a clearer question about what users understand, trust, or know how to do next. The next cycle should resolve the remaining uncertainty around Platform Diagram Update.

surfaced_findings.title: EDC Blueprint Page
surfaced_findings.finding_statement: Users understand the Enterprise Data Cloud category, but the Blueprint page still needs to make the assessment and workshop outcome clearer before asking visitors to start.
surfaced_findings.proof_point: EDC Blueprint Users understand the Enterprise Data Cloud category, but they don't clearly understand what the Blueprint delivers or why they should start the assessment.
surfaced_findings.next_step: Clarify what the assessment produces, preview the value of the workshop or output, and validate whether visitors understand why starting the assessment is worth their time.

surfaced_findings.title: Accelerate Live Stream
surfaced_findings.finding_statement: The live stream experience needs to make the event feel live immediately and guide visitors toward one dominant “Watch Live” action.
surfaced_findings.proof_point: Accelerate Live Stream The biggest opportunity is making it immediately obvious that the event is live and guiding users toward a single dominant "Watch Live" action.
surfaced_findings.next_step: Make “Watch Live” the dominant action, add immediate live-state cues, and test whether visitors can tell what is happening now versus what is available later.

surfaced_findings.title: Contextual Intelligence PDP
surfaced_findings.finding_statement: Contextual Intelligence is recognizable as an AI and data management topic, but the differentiation and business value need to become clearer and more operational.
surfaced_findings.proof_point: Contextual Intelligence Users recognize the AI and data management category, but the differentiation and business value of contextual intelligence need to be clearer and easier to understand.
surfaced_findings.next_step: Translate contextual intelligence into concrete business value and operational trust cues, then validate whether users can explain what makes the capability different.

comparison_tests.title: Platform Diagram Update
comparison_tests.finding_statement: Platform Diagram Update is best treated as a narrowed comparison problem: the next decision should protect the clearest user behavior rather than reopen broad creative exploration.
comparison_tests.decision_criteria: Choose the strongest direction based on first-glance comprehension, clarity of the next step, user confidence, and whether the page helps visitors complete the intended task.
comparison_tests.next_step: Simplify the platform diagram around one AI-ready data-platform story and test whether users describe the platform as intelligent and connected rather than only storage-oriented.

unresolved_questions.title: Platform Diagram Update
unresolved_questions.question: Does the simplified diagram shift perception toward an intelligent AI-ready data platform, or does it still read like a storage architecture diagram?

unresolved_questions.title: EDC Blueprint Page
unresolved_questions.question: Do visitors understand what they get from the assessment and why the workshop is worth engaging with before they have enough context?

unresolved_questions.title: Contextual Intelligence PDP
unresolved_questions.question: Can users explain what contextual intelligence does differently and why that difference matters operationally?

next_actions.action: Translate contextual intelligence into concrete business value and operational trust cues, then validate whether users can explain what makes the capability different.
Make “Watch Live” the dominant action, add immediate live-state cues, and test whether visitors can tell what is happening now versus what is available later.
Clarify what the assessment produces, preview the value of the workshop or output, and validate whether visitors understand why starting the assessment is worth their time.
Simplify the platform diagram around one AI-ready data-platform story and test whether users describe the platform as intelligent and connected rather than only storage-oriented.
Run the next webinar review as a barrier diagnosis: separate value clarity, form effort, session detail, and post-registration expectation so the team knows what is blocking progression.

note: The next cycle should keep each active workstream tied to a concrete user behavior: what people understand, trust, find, choose, or feel ready to do next.
